setting.help: Maintain a per-client deterioration-risk snapshot (the ranked worklist) from the telemonitoring signals. Turn off to freeze recomputation entirely.
Run the periodic sweep that refreshes the whole worklist and prunes stale snapshots. Event-driven recomputes still run when the engine is enabled.

Keep an append-only trail of each client's risk score over time (the worklist trend arrows and the Risk Score trajectory chart). Turn off to stop appending new history points; existing points and the trend arrows still show.
